Short introduction:
Aerodiagnostika (a.k.a. THRUST - Intelligent UAV Sysstems) is a startup developing drone / UAV based data gathering platform and integrating it with advanced analytics (including artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions). Our core innovation lies in our UAVs which are designed to fly low and slow in order to gather high quality data. Also, the design allows it to maintain long endurance endurance and cover up to300 km in one mission. So far, our main focus was in electricity grid diagnostics, however, we are currently developing solutions for agriculture (RGB+ multispectral cameras) and forestry (RGB + Multispectral + LiDAR). We see great potential in combining UAV (micro level) and satellite data (macro level) for remote sensing.

Our history:
AeroDiagnostika was founded in 2018 when a team of engineers led by Robertas Urbanavičius, a PhD with 40+ years of experience, applied know-how acquired in security & defense sector to create a superior drone for civilian data gathering purposes – GreenBee UAV. The company currently led by Daiva Urbanavičienė (repeatedly awarded as the best female CEO in Lithuania) successfully attracted €1.3M in R&D financing from various instruments, which allowed us to reach TRL7 – GreenBee prototype has been demonstrated and validated in actual operational environment with test flights and data collection performed in agriculture, environmental and power grid sectors. Our innovation and competitive advantage rely on our superior drones, however we see our core business as drone services and data analytics company. In 2020 Aerodiagnostika rebranded as THRUST – Intelligent UAV systems.

Our innovation:
Our drone is designed to gather maximum quality data: fly low and slow (43 km/h) while being stable and resistant to wind (20 m/s). Also, it can carry up to 8 kg of sensors and still weigh below 25 kg (civilian drone weight class). Furthermore, it has endurance of up to 8 hours and can cover up to 300 km in one mission, while still being green (0.35 l of fuel per h). Which gives us a competitive advantage against other UAVs and allows us to gather micro level data on large scale.

Founded in 1994 MBN Nanomaterialia (www.mbn.it) is a producer of metal powder materials trough a proprietary mechano-chemical synthesis process technology (Mechanomade). Materials of MBN have an ultrafine crystalline structure which delivers unique physical and mechanical properties resulting in superior performance when compared to existing alloys. MBN powders consist in conventional micron-sized particles that do not contain any nano-sized particulates and can be safely utilized in the mainstream industries by powder metallurgy processes, spraying coating and laser AM.
Main products lines range from ferrous and nonferrous alloys for cutting tools to Titanium based alloys for biomedical prosthesis and ODS alloys for high temperature resistance components (aerospace, energy). MBN is also a producer of customized materials for additive manufacturing based on Titanium Alluminides and high purity composites for sputtering targets and thermal spraying powders for coatings.
As far as it concerns powder used for AM laser processing, the engineering and development is totally accomplished in-house, without or partially resorting to powder end user’s facilities, thanks to the availability of a laser deposition MLD and spraying job-shop.
MBN is a ISO 9001:2008 certified company which ensure the supply of high quality grade raw materials for the industry. MBN is also a validated supplier of biomedical Titanium powder conforming standard specification ASTM F1580-12. 
The MBN team is a specialist in advance material manufacturing and have an extensive experience in project leadership and management for large research and development projects.

entityDescription: AMIGO s.r.l. is the first Italian SME working on climate service. The company was founded by two climate experts with 20-years of experience in 2013, starting for the idea that there was a lack of an easy-to-use solution for the climate risk assessment. The limitations of existing solutions motivated Sandro Calmanti and Marcello Petitta to begin the journey that brought AMIGO from an R&D project funded by the UN World Food Programme to finalizing AMIGOclimate, proprietary AI-powered software to support Insurance and Reinsurance companies to manage climate risk. During the last 7 years of intense R&D activity, AMIGO has designed three other innovative modular plugins for the quality control and the spacial refinement of climate data, and for the risk assessment over seasonal time-horizons. Parallel to the R&D projects, AMIGO has been heavily active in consultancy for international organisations, gaining, among other tenders, two 3+1 year Long Term Agreements with the UN World Food Programme in 2015. AMIGO was also one of 6 teams winning the 1st European Data Incubator in 2019. The company is currently involved in four H2020 projects on climate services for the insurance market, the aviation sector, the rural development and infrastructure management. All this was possible thanks to a highly motivated, multi-disciplinary team of experts guided by the CEO, Sara Dal Gesso. The core expertise of the AMIGO team ranges from climate science to Big Data and AI, from software development to socio-economic assessment, from strategic design to business development. AMIGOclimate is the innovative software at the heart of the company's strategy of growth and internationalisation, being the key asset to scale-up from a consultancy SME to a software service provider to large enterprises. With this software solution, AMIGO aims to become the European leader in the market of climate services for the insurance sector, hence taking part in the continental effort for a resilient society under the umbrella of the European Green Deal.

W4E is a spin-off company of the Offshore Renewable Energy’s research group led by Prof. Giuliana Mattiazzo from Politecnico di Torino and boasts more then 10 years of experience in the field of marine energy. The company pursues the challenge of creating new opportunities for clean and sustainable energy supply from the most promising resources on the planet. Generate electricity from the waves is in fact one of the biggest challenges today.
Since its inception, the main efforts of W4E were directed to the creation of Wave Energy Converter (WEC) devices. Starting from the optimization of control algorithms and arriving at the study of interactions with the marine environment, W4E has developed an innovative proprietary technology called ISWEC (Inertial Sea Wave Energy Converter).
Being able to instal a full scale ISWEC, W4E has grown expertise in multidisciplinary fields ranging from mechanical to electrical engineering, from wave dynamics to mooring architectures, from legislation to environmental aspects, from politics to regulation plans for the grid connection, from the forecast to offshore operations and much more.
During its growth, W4E has faced typical problems of the offshore energy industry, having to deal with the aggressive marine environment. Only the partnership with other experienced companies in such an industry has allowed the company to achieve successful results. The collaboration with Eni allowed the launch of an industrialization plan that today has made technology jump from TRL 5 to TRL 7 in just two years.
The objectives and the steps forward to bring ISWEC to a TRL 9 are clear and already planned. Thanks to previous experiences, today W4E is a company that works in the field of innovative engineering and technology transfer, with the aim of developing complex technological solutions with the focus on energy supply systems from renewable sources in an offshore environment.

entityDescription:
"TITANIA, Ensayos y Proyectos Industriales S.L.", is a “spin-off“ company (SME) emerging from the Research Activities of the Group of Corrosion and Protection (LABCYP) of the University of Cádiz (UCA). Established in 2006, TITANIA focuses its activities on the quality control of materials and the development of R&D project for the Aerospace Industry, and to a lesser extent in the study and quality control works for the Maritime and Automobile Industry. The company is sustainably growing from its foundation. Currently, TITANIA has around 60 employees and it is located in the Tecnobahía technology park in El Puerto de Santa Maria (Cádiz) with more than 2,500 m2 of full equipped laboratories.
The capabilities of TITANIA cover most of the materials that are part of an airplane: metals, fasteners, composites, paints, sealants and adhesives. TITANIA has different technical units or laboratories that perform the characterization of its properties: mechanical laboratories, microscopy, corrosion, climate, surface and union, physical-chemical, thermal analysis and non-destructive testing technologies. TTITANIA has the approval of major aeronautical manufacturers such as AIRBUS GROUP (by its three divisions), BOMBARDIER, EMBRAER, BOEING and SIKORSKY, as well as recognition of their technical competence by ENAC/ILAC (ISO 17025) and NADCAP accreditation entities (MTL, NMMT and NDT). These capabilities enable TITANIA to have a regular R&D activity at national level so that it participates in the development of projects with leading companies in the aeronautical sector, expanding its research activity to other sectors such as the naval, energy or infrastructure.

Currently, the company is spreading its field of action, being space on of the most relevant new sectors to focus on.
